status: prospective implementation contract; no scientific data

instance.field: p prime >3 is an explicit mathematical input premise unless a separate primality certificate is supplied. Probable-prime checks are never called a proof.
instance.curve: a,b reduced modulo p; discriminant nonzero; R=(r,t) on curve and t!=0.
instance.domains: D1,D2 each a modular interval window {h+i:0<=i<B}, 0<=B<=p, or an explicit list of distinct canonical field elements. Reject duplicate explicit coordinates. Infinity is not an affine-domain element.
instance.order: Preserve a deterministic declared D1 order; second-domain membership and indexing setup are explicit.
instance.sqrt_setup: Use p=3 mod4 shortcut or a correct general prime-field square-root algorithm. Supply and verify a nonsquare or charge every setup probe. Uniform random sampling assumptions are required for any expected O(1) probe claim.
instance.nonsquare_certificate_option: Permit a shared Euler-certified nonsquare Z and per-nonroot w^2=Z*f(x), w!=0. Charge finding/certifying Z and producing w (including its square root) separately; ordinary per-row Euler is an explicit fallback. No improvement is presumed.

producer_requirements: Enumerate D1 exactly once; evaluate f(x), determine no root/zero root/two roots without scanning all y in Fp.
For each rational lift P, compute Q=R-P by complete group arithmetic and test affine D2 membership; handle P=R, P=-R, doubling, inverse and zero ordinate.

All mode has exactly one lift-status record for every distinct D1 x, no missing or duplicate records. Positive/zero cases carry a checked square root and both signs, once for zero. Nonroot rows carry either Euler -1, or a nonzero w with w^2=Z*f(x) for one global Z certified nonsquare by Euler.
All mode returns the complete ordered projected (x1,x2) set and rational witnesses P,Q; all-mode complete=true only after domain exhaustion. No scalar recovery claim.
First mode returns a checked witness when found and always completeness=false; exhaustion without witness is not upgraded to a complete certificate by that mode.

Keep setup, domain representation, membership, root extraction, group work, output/certificate storage and independent verification costs distinct. Descriptive software event counts are optional, not performance measurements or total CPU counts.
checker_requirements: Do not import producer arithmetic, membership or solution enumeration helpers.

Validate exact D1 lift-record coverage. For positive/zero cases check y^2=f(x), both signs and the single zero root. For a nonroot row either check Euler -1 or verify nonzero w and w^2=Z*f(x) with one globally Euler-certified nonsquare Z. These are alternatives, not interchangeable unverified assertions.
Independently derive the S3 polynomial in z: h=x-r,c=-r*x-2*r^2-a; coefficients h^2,2*h*c-4*t^2,c^2-4*t^2*(x+r); discriminant16*t^2*f(x).

For h!=0 enumerate all rational quadratic roots from the certified square root; for h=0 handle the nonzero linear coefficient -4*t^2 explicitly. Apply D2 membership and compare the complete ordered projected set.
Separately verify every returned point lies on E and sums to R using independently implemented complete group rules. Verify first-mode witness without claiming completeness.
Reject missing/duplicate lift records, missing signs or exceptional roots, malformed witnesses, duplicate projected outputs, wrong curve/target and false completeness claims.
cost_statement_target: setup(D1,D2,p) + O(B1*(S(p)+Euler(p)+group(p)+membership(D2))) + output/construction/checking costs, with exact primitive-count assumptions and no hidden O(p) y scan or B1*B2 pair loop. Arithmetic bit cost and domain-memory choice remain explicit.

software_integrity_fixtures.domains: Full canonical domains on these tiny fields, plus empty/window/explicit-domain boundary tests; no input selected from observed solver outcomes.
software_integrity_fixtures.reference_oracle: A tiny exhaustive y/point-pair oracle is permitted only inside software tests, never in the operational producer or complete checker.
mutation_controls: zero or corrupted nonsquare-row w when that certificate option is implemented
software_integrity_fixtures.reporting: unittest/pytest pass/fail with fixed test identities and source hashes only; no timing comparison, scaling curve, scientific success-rate claim or PNEXT replay.
